prevItem.title: Atoll Misao
prevItem.excerpt:
The Atoll Misao is a high-end, Japanese-made swimming popper designed primarily for big-game offshore fishing. Crafted from wood, it is renowned for its unique slim profile and a specifically angled "cut" above the mouth that allows it to generate fine bubbles while swimming in a distinct S-shaped motion.

A "Swimming Hopper" action where it dives just below the surface, trailing a bubble line while maintaining a stable S-curve swim.

Its slim, balanced body minimizes air resistance, allowing for long-distance casting even in windy offshore conditions.

Handmade from wood to prioritize natural buoyancy and action, though this makes it more susceptible to damage from high-impact strikes or structural stress compared to plastic lures

  • Length 215 mm - Gr. 100

  • Length 230 mm - Gr. 105
